assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / UI asset extraction.
The input images are the four approved Android interface mockups. Produce a clean reusable TRANSPARENT PNG atlas matching their exact visual language. Preserve the champagne/ivory metallic outlines, muted navy glass, restrained crimson accents, and fine ornamental diamonds. NO wallpaper, characters, phone frames, labels other than explicitly requested text, watermark, sheet background or baked checkerboard. The PNG outside each object must genuinely have alpha 0. Keep each atlas cell perfectly aligned to a regular grid and inside its own cell, with equal gutters. This is a production asset used in Flutter, not a new screen design.
Extract/recreate the EXACT classic elegant serif letterforms of the approved titles and capsule labels. Output one portrait atlas with TEN equal-height horizontal rows, width:height approximately 4:5. Every row has a single line centered, generous transparent padding for Vietnamese accents. All rows use the SAME serif font family and consistent ivory/champagne text style; NO button frames, rules, icons or other decoration. Preserve correct Vietnamese spelling verbatim.
Rows top to bottom:
1 "THIẾT LẬP"
2 "CẬP NHẬT"
3 "THÔNG BÁO"
4 "CÀI ĐẶT"
5 "CÀI TIẾNG VIỆT"
6 "KIỂM TRA CẬP NHẬT"
7 "LƯU CÀI ĐẶT"
8 "Tắt"
9 "Tắt trong 24 giờ"
10 "Khôi phục gốc"
Rows1-4 should precisely match the high contrast classical serif uppercase page headings in input screens; rows5-7 same serif as the burgundy capsule buttons; rows8-10 same serif in the quiet action buttons/restore link. These are readable typeset glyphs with antialiased transparent edges, not hand lettering. No misspelled accents or substitutions.

Copy shapes and cream/gold coloring from the mockups, especially the large key, Wi-Fi, heart, gear, notification bell, cube, and file download icons. No glow clouds or raster checker background.

No text, no icons, no full dark fills, no multicolor effects. All four frames use matching metallic thickness. Keep straight top/bottom/side stretches plain so a nine-slice renderer can resize them.
